name: project
postCreateCommand: CODEx_HOME="/home/${DEV_USERNAME:-dev}/.codex"; mkdir -p "$CODEx_HOME/skills"; if ! touch "$CODEx_HOME/.write-test" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Codex directory is not writable: $CODEx_HOME" >&2; echo "Linux/WSL: run sudo chown -R \"${DEV_UID:-1000}:${DEV_GID:-1000}\" data/.codex from the project root." >&2; echo "Windows/macOS: check Docker Desktop file sharing and mount path settings." >&2; exit 1; fi; rm -f "$CODEx_HOME/.write-test"; if [ -d "$CODEx_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills/.git" ]; then git -C "$CODEx_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills" pull --ff-only; elif [ ! -e "$CODEx_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills" ]; then git clone https://github.com/fmarslan/ai-skills "$CODEx_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills"; else echo "Codex skills path exists but is not a git checkout: $CODEx_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills"; fi
